lead.headline: 94 ex-members of Congress later filed foreign-agent forms; five filed in 2025, including Blagojevich for Bosnia and Fattah for Liberia
lead.number: 94 ex-members (left office 1970 or later) filed FARA short forms after leaving; 26 first filed 2017+; 5 in 2025: Wexler, Blagojevich, Stewart, Fattah, Seymour (weak match).
lead.watch_out: Name-only match with at least one sure miss ("Stephanie Jones" filed in 2019; Stephanie Tubbs Jones died in 2008), and no dollars.
